description: The chart illustrates accuracy results (in percent) for two conditions, “Audio” and “Noise,” across three model categories, with a dashed reference line for “Random Choice.” The category axis is horizontal and shows three groups labeled (from left to right) an unlabeled/blank first group, “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” with two adjacent bars per group. The value axis is vertical, labeled “Accuracy (%),” using a linear scale from 0 to 60 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. In each group, the “Audio” bar is colored blue and the “Noise” bar is colored purple; in the leftmost (blank-labeled) group, the Audio bar is at about 30% and the Noise bar is about 23%; for “Audio-Reasoner,” the Audio bar is about 36% and the Noise bar is about 30%; for “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” the Audio bar is about 56–57% and the Noise bar is about 36%. A light blue dashed horizontal line labeled “Random Choice” runs across the plot at approximately 29%. The bars are presented as grouped pairs rather than stacked, there is no explicit sorting indicated beyond the left-to-right category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the legend and the reference line.
